title: Bar Drop Rhubarb Raspberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Rhubarb Raspberry by Drop is a garden-fresh blend that celebrates tart fruit flavours. It pairs the unique, sharp tang of rhubarb with the bright, sweet-sour notes of raspberry. This combination creates a lively and mouth-watering profile that balances acidity with fruity sweetness perfectly. This nic salt e-liquid features a specific 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, designed to maximise flavour transmission. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile where the tart rhubarb notes really shine. Suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
